svg.text: AtmosMesh Room v2 — perfboard zone map, 31 × 27 holes, component-side view, USB toward column 1
Red = 5 V domain, green = 3.3 V sensor rail regulator and CO₂ block, blue = 3.3 V sensor edges, yellow = switched loads. Zones are placement corridors; wiring.md is authoritative by pin name.
5 V fence: nothing left of this line carries 5 V except the U2 feed
